cases.doc: The join pulled more USDC than `max_usdc` allows.
cases.name: SpendCapExceeded

cases.doc: The Comet join minted less LP than `min_lp_out`.
cases.name: LpBelowMin

cases.doc: The fill left more LP in the wallet than `max_lp_residual` \xe2\x80\x94 we would\nbe carrying BLND exposure to the next auction, which is the exact\nthing this contract exists to prevent.
cases.name: LpResidual

cases.doc: The fill returned less lot than `min_lot_out` (we did not actually win,\nor won less than we priced).
cases.name: LotBelowMin

`auction_user` is not the backstop. For a type-2 auction the auction's
`user` key IS the backstop contract; a mismatch means the caller built
the request from the wrong template (the type-0 shape puts a borrower
there) and would be filling something we did not price.
cases.name: AuctionKeyMismatch

udt_struct_v0.doc: Blend's `submit` request element. Field names and types must match the\npool's `Request` exactly; the encoding is a symbol-keyed map, so the\ndeclaration order here is irrelevant to the wire format.
udt_struct_v0.name: Request

function_v0.doc:
Mint the bid and win the auction in one invocation.

* `filler` \xe2\x80\x94 whose money moves and who receives the lot. Must
authorize; this is the ONLY principal the call can act for.
* `usdc` \xe2\x80\x94 the SAC of the asset deposited into the Comet pool
(mainnet USDC `CCW67TSZ\xe2\x80\xa6`). Named separately from the lot asset
because they only happen to coincide.
* `usdc_in` \xe2\x80\x94 units to deposit single-sided.
* `max_usdc` \xe2\x80\x94 hard ceiling on what the join may actually pull. Checked
against the measured balance delta, so a Comet that took more than it
was asked for reverts the whole transaction.
* `comet` \xe2\x80\x94 the Comet BLND:USDC pool. A Comet pool IS its own LP share
token (it implements the token interface), so this address is used
both as the join target and as the LP balance oracle.
* `min_lp_out` \xe2\x80\x94 slippage floor on the join, doing three jobs: it is
passed to Comet as its own `min_pool_amount_out`, re-checked here
against the measured LP delta, and used verbatim as the LP allowance
granted to the backstop \xe2\x80\x94 so it must be a
function_v0.name: fill_interest
